description.mn: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Blue: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан модлог үнэр (EDT). Зүрхний ноот: лаванда, розмарин, хар чинжүү; суурь ноот: хув, тонка шош, зандан мод.
description.en: The scent balances an energetic opening, a spicy development and an addictive trail. Frozen apple, combined with juicy bergamot and aromatic cardamom, gives an exciting first impression. A mix of pepper, rosemary and crisp lavender brightens up the heart while giving it an effortless flair. At the base, addictive amber, supported by rich Sandalwood and Tonka Beans, leaves a deeper trail of unexpected tones. It is Abercrombie’s fragrant interpretation of the moment of exhilaration when you feel the sky’s the limit. A fresh, one-of-a-kind Fougere scent for the adventurous man whose lives by his First Instinct. Head Notes: Frozen Apple, Cardamom, Bergamot Heart Notes: Crisp Lavender, Rosemary, Pepper Base Notes: Addictive Amber, Tonka Beans, Sandalwood
